notes:
⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer)

This is a Webflow CMS site with client-side rendering using Finsweet CMS Library. The property listings are NOT present in the static HTML and must be scraped with a headless browser.

Key Technical Details:
- Built on Webflow CMS
- Uses Finsweet CMS Library (fs-list-element attributes)
- Dynamic content loaded via JavaScript
- Collection list containers use: .w-dyn-list > .w-dyn-items > .w-dyn-item
- Properties are ranch/land listings, not businesses
- Main listings page: https://www.texasranchesforsale.com/ (homepage serves as listings page)
- Individual listing URLs follow pattern: /listings/[county]-[property-name]

To scrape successfully:
1. Use Playwright/Selenium to load page
2. Wait for .w-dyn-items to populate (wait for network idle or specific element)
3. Look for property cards within .w-dyn-item containers
4. Property details may be in custom classes (needs JS inspection in browser DevTools)

Sample listing URLs found in updates:
- https://www.texasranchesforsale.com/listings/gillespie-county-2330-summit-forest-nw-fredericksburg-ranch-for-sale
- https://www.texasranchesforsale.com/listings/edwards-county-bbr-ranch-nw-rocksprings-ranch-for-sale

The selectors provided are estimates based on common Webflow patterns. Actual class names must be confirmed by inspecting the rendered page in a browser.
